lines.text: After that, I enjoy my school life to the fullest... or rather...
As Arcana would put it, I'm enjoying my youth.
Then, one day...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: We'll be ending class a bit early today.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I have an announcement to make.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: It's about the most important event of the semester.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: The most important event?

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Ugh... as long as it's not something like a mock exam.
Tension begins to fill the classroom.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Whew...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I am, of course, referring to...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: The festival!

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Huh? There's going to be a festival?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: As you all know, our school is very closed off.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Because of that, the school's public image has gradually worsened.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: In an attempt to improve our image, we're going to hold a festival that will be open to the public.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: So it'll be like the festivals other regular schools have?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Yes, that's correct.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Each class and club will need to decide on a theme.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Wow, that sounds fun!

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: It'll be nice to have a break as well.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: I wonder what our class will end up doing.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: It's finally starting.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: The highlight of our time at this school.
True.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: How about this?

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: We could make and sell accessories or keychains!

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Naru dolls! Naru keychains!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: That sounds good! Ein is good with her hands too.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Er... I'm not really good at that kind of thing, so I'm not sure how much I can help...

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: I haven't made anything like that before either.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Hmm, it won't be fair if someone ends up doing all the work alone. Next!

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Any other ideas?

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: I never even thought we'd be doing something like a festival.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: I'm fine with anything, as long as it's fun.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I think I'll be doing something with my club instead.
Everyone tosses around ideas, but nothing gets decided.
In that case...
I raise my hand.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Yes, {AccountData.NickName}. Do you have any good ideas?
A maid cafe.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Th-that's...!

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Oh yeah! Didn't you say you worked at a maid cafe before, Miss Privaty?

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Whoa! Does that mean we're going to wear maid outfits?

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Maid outfits?!

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: That sounds a bit embarrassing...

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Do we really have to wear maid outfits?

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: I doubt they'll expect that much from students.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: I'm sure just saying "Welcome, Master!" would be enough.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Y-you think so?

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Serving customers should be easy enough.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Argh...!
Privaty's face turns bright red as she glares at me with resentment.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: *Sigh*

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Fine. Looks like I don't have a choice.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: If there are no objections, a maid cafe it—
At that moment, Amy quietly raises her hand.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Yes, Amy.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Do you have a better idea?

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: I don't want to participate.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Sorry?

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Isn't this supposed to be a place where Nikkes are supposed to train and prove themselves?

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: I didn't come here to make a spectacle of myself.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Make a spectacle of yourself? That's not what this is about.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: With all the pressure you face at school, we just want to give you all a little time to enjoy yourselves.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: But earlier you said it was to help improve the school's public image.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: That's part of it, of course, but that's not the whole reason.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: We know you're all struggling under the constant pressure of exams.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: So if we participate in the festival, do we automatically pass the next exam?

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Festival preparation will take up a lot of our time, after all.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Er... well...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: That's something I've yet to confirm...
The school bell rings.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Oh.
Amy immediately gets up and heads to the door.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: A-Amy!
As soon as the bell stop ringing, Amy leaves the classroom.
Together, Arcana and I chase after Amy.
In the distance, I see Amy sitting on a bench.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: A-Amyyyy!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: *Huff, huff*

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: ... You're already out of breath from running that little?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Wh-what do you mean?!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I ran sooo much!

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Here, drink some water.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Th-thanks...
After Arcana catches her breath,
Amy begins to speak.
About how she was scared before coming to this school.
How she felt inadequate, and wondered if she could handle it.
But with Arcana and I, she's been able to enjoy her time at school.
Then, hearing about the festival brought her back to reality.
As Arcana listens with a serious expression, she takes Amy's hand.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: All right, how about this.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You heard what Ms. Privaty said earlier.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Each club also needs to decide on a theme and concept.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Yeah... she did.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: It doesn't matter whether it's our club or a new one that you join.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Either way, that's where you show everyone

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: what you have achieved.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: My... achievements?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Yes. That's right.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: This might sound strange coming from someone who isn't even a proper student...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: But I think there's a reason they chose to treat us as students throughout this whole experience.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: If it were just about imparting knowledge and training us,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: there'd be plenty of other ways to do that, right?

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: ... That's true.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: That's why I've decided the theme of what you need to prepare and show.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: And that is...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Youth.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You're going to show everyone

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: the kind of life you're living right now as a student!

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: ... Pfft.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... I'm being serious here.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: I know. I can tell how seriously you take this kind of thing now.
Amy lets out a contented sigh.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: ... I'll think about it a little more.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: I mean...
Amy stands up.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: I'm going to go talk to Miss Privaty.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: I was really rude earlier. I should apologize to her first...

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: I also want to have an honest talk with her... the way a young person should.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Okay!
Amy leaves with a smile.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Whew... that took ten years off my life...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Not to mention, I nearly lost a dear friend.
I don't think it was that big a deal...
But you did great. You were pretty cool back there.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Thanks.
Arcana watches Amy's retreating figure, then suddenly speaks up.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Come to think of it, what about you, {AccountData.NickName}?
Huh?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Well... it's not just about the festival.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: It is an important event,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: and it kind of feels like... how should I put it... the culmination of our youth.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: But realistically speaking, once the festival ends, our school life ends too.
Hmm... that's true.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: So, with the time we have left...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: What do you want to do?
I want you to be able to do what you want.
I want to spend more time alone with you.
*Rustle*
I take out the photo the three of us took together the other day, with Amy.
I want to spend a little more time together. Just the two of us.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... Okay. Then let's go.
Where to?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Somewhere we can be alone. Just the two of us.
